user.title: Météo-France API Configuration
user.description:
Enter your Météo-France API token to access avalanche risk assessment bulletins (BRA).

To get a free token:
1. Create an account on [{api_portal_url}]({api_portal_url})
2. Subscribe to the 'Données Publiques BRA' API
3. Copy your API token

This token will be used for all your mountain ranges. You will then pick a first mountain range.

department.title: Department Selection
department.description: Select the department where the mountain range you want to monitor is located.

massif.title: Mountain Range Selection
massif.description:
Select the mountain range for which you want to receive avalanche risk assessment bulletins.

You can add more mountain ranges later from the integration page, with the "Add mountain range" button.

reconfigure.title: Update API Token
reconfigure.description:
Update your Météo-France API token.

It will be used by all your mountain ranges.

reauth_confirm.title: API Token Rejected
reauth_confirm.description:
The Météo-France API rejected your token. Enter a new token from [{api_portal_url}]({api_portal_url}).

It will be used by all your mountain ranges.
